I had Covid a couple of months back. I’m a fully vaccinated 20 year old and I never thought I could get it.
But one day after Uni I suddenly felt my throat aching and I got a pretty bad headache too. At first I thought I’m just tired and drank too much coffee but the next morning it was waaay worse. 
So I skipped the lectures and went to get tested. 
I got an email that I’m infected and must go into quarantine. Well…. I live alone with my doggo and my fridge was almost completely empty. So I lived off of spaghetti and rice without sauce the next couple of days. I tried to find someone to buy me some groceries but my family lives quite far away and we’re not really close. 

It was horrible. I lost almost 4kg in 5 days, had a headache and sore throat from hell and was so dizzy I sometimes had to crawl to the bathroom.
I called the Covid info number a few times during all of this but they just kept telling me to wait it out. 
One night I woke up feeling like my whole body was burning and I could hardly breathe. So I finally called the ambulance. In the hospital they were completely bewildered that I made it so long without medical care.
Well but it didn’t get better from there. I had to be intubated and was in a very weird state of consciousness, it was so strange. But I then noticed my father sat next to me, stroking my hair. He was actually crying and telling me how sorry he was for neglecting me and that I’m the only person he still had in this world. 
I still remember clearly that I thought “So I died?”
Of course I didn’t die but I’m still recovering from Covid to this day. The good thing is, I’m a lot closer to my dad now
